bugs.error_message: User: clicking a session opens a NEW window instead of the window it is running in
bugs.root_cause: openSession ran `open -b com.microsoft.VSCode <cwd>`. Passing the folder to `open` makes VS Code open that folder as a new window rather than focusing the running session window; for a non-running host `open -b` also launches a fresh window.
bugs.fix: SessionLauncher.focus now activates the running instance via NSRunningApplication.runningApplications(withBundleIdentifier:).first?.activate(options:[.activateAllWindows]); falls back to `open -b` only when the app is not running. No path passed, so no new window is opened. Shared by row tap + notification action.

bugs.error_message: User: context-usage cylinder grid's filled cell count visually disagreed with the displayed percentage text (e.g. showed "16%" but looked like more cells were lit)
bugs.root_cause: FeedWatcher.applyStatus rounded the raw Double used_percentage to an Int (contextPct) for display. MenuContentView then divided that already-rounded Int by 2.5 and rounded again to pick how many of the 40 grid cells to fill. Two independent roundings from two different value domains (percent, then cell count) could disagree by a visible cell.
bugs.fix: Added SessionFeed.contextPctRaw: Double (stores ctx.used_percentage before rounding) and FeedWatcher.usageContextPctRaw computed property exposing it. MenuContentView's filledCount now derives from this raw double (falling back to Double(pct) if unavailable) instead of the pre-rounded Int, so only one rounding step occurs and the grid stays consistent with the underlying value.
